// REQ: LANG-1431 LANG-1432 LANG-1433
#include <module.h>
/* Block comment */
class Greeter {
  string name = "world";

  string greet(int times) {
    string text = "Hello, " + name + "!\n";
    return text * times;
  }
}

int main(int argc, array(string) argv) {
  Greeter g = Greeter();
  mapping(string:int) ages = (["ann": 30]);
  foreach (indices(ages), string who) write(g->greet(2) + who + 'x');
  return 0x1F > 0;
}
